item.title: Overview of Daniel - Exile, Empire, and the Everlasting Kingdom 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # There are seasons in life when a person suddenly realizes that the world around them is larger, more demanding, and more morally complex than they ever imagined. Picture a young woman named Mara, newly accepted into a prestigious international internship. She arrives in a foreign city whose skyline glitters with ambition and whose streets pulse with a culture that is not her own. On her first day, she is ushered into a towering glass building where executives stride through the halls with the confidence of people who believe they shape the future. The company is powerful, admired, and feared. Its influence reaches far beyond its walls, shaping markets, policies, and even the behavior of its employees.

item.title: Overview of Ezekiel - Wheels of Glory, Bones of Hope, Rivers of Life 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # A man once climbed onto his roof to adjust a stubborn television aerial. It was one of those quiet afternoons when the sky is calm, the neighbourhood still, and the mind occupied with small tasks that feel harmless. But as he leaned forward to tighten a bolt, his foot slipped on a patch of dust, and suddenly the world tilted beneath him. He slid toward the gutter, scrambling for anything to hold. His hands caught the eaves trough, and there he hung, suspended between the familiar safety of the roof and the unknown distance below.

item.title: Overview of Isaiah - The Grand Canyon of Divine Salvation
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # When Sarah first wandered into the book of Isaiah, it was not during a quiet devotional morning or in the structured rhythm of a Bible‑reading plan, but in the fluorescent‑lit waiting room of a city hospital, where the air carried the faint smell of antiseptic and the low hum of machines that seemed to echo the anxiety of everyone seated beneath them. Her father had been rushed into emergency surgery after collapsing at home, and the day had unfolded with the disorienting speed that turns ordinary hours into something heavy and unreal. She had brought her Bible almost without thinking, more out of habit than expectation, and for a long time it lay unopened beside her while she scrolled through her phone, trying to distract herself from the fear that kept rising in her chest.

item.title: Overview of Deuteronomy - The Law that Delivers
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections_ INTRODUCTION - A STORY OF STARTING OVER # Aria had spent years drifting, with good intentions, bad habits, and a long trail of half-finished commitments. After a painful setback, she decided to start over. She bought a new journal, wrote “A Fresh Beginning” on the first page, and promised herself she would live differently this time.
